verdict.rationale: The docs say Entrust performs NFC data extraction from documents as part of a Document report, and that workflow results can be retrieved via webhook or polling. That suggests extracted document data is part of the results a developer can retrieve, but no item shows the extracted fields being returned as structured API data. Missing for 10: documented structured extracted-field output (name, date of birth, document number, address, expiry) in the API/report schema, OCR (non-NFC) extraction evidence, an example response payload, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, verified sessions return the extracted document fields as structured data — name, date of birth, document number, address, expiry — retrievable via the API, not just a pass/fail flag

citations.quote: Entrust supports NFC data extraction from documents such as ePassports to verify document and biometric data as part of a Document report.
retrieve results via webhook or polling
